summary: Iter 49/54 verification. Backend: ran 4 pytest files (test_iter49_ecommerce_v2, test_iter49_batch1, test_iter49_log_archive, test_iter51_new_gaps) = 52 passed, 1 skipped (staff role skip, expected). Every ecommerce v2 requirement passed: migration-status>=2, /ecommerce/products grid shape, upsert never duplicates (platform,item), 400 on live-without-commission, 400 on new-listing-without-price, delist all platforms, order still decrements stock, cancel/return restores once, legacy listings/orders/reconciliation/import routes intact. Regressions covered too: brand_returns report shape+filters, report_usage view+export logging + self-exclusion, log_archive purge guard/idempotency, partner district multi-filter (OR) + district sort + type-switch guardrails + audit, vendor location_asc sort. Frontend: Ecommerce page /dashboard/ecommerce has exactly two tabs (ecommerce-tab-products + ecommerce-tab-orders) with all required data-testids present (products-table, manage-platforms-btn, add-product-btn, products-search-input, products-platform-filter, orders-count, orders-revenue, orders-pending-count, orders-mismatch-count, orders-table, add-order-btn, import-orders-btn, toggle-reconciliation-btn). Old TEST47_P_* platforms + TEST-ORD-* orders migrated (visible as columns/rows) — no data loss. CEO Dashboard ceo-report-download-btn labelled 'Download CEO Report' triggers download of CEO_Report_2026-09-06.pdf (~237KB). pypdf confirms exactly 1 page and text contains Total Revenue (Rs 12,97,959), Company Health score, Sales/Profit/Cash/Ops/Team component scores, Cash on Hand, Support tickets, Project Status counts, Sales Funnel, Revenue Trend, Top Performing Staff, Customer Credit Aging, Top 5 Outstanding, Top Recurring Support Categories, and channel breakdown (project/counter/ecommerce). After download, GET /api/reports/report_usage returns a row report_type='ceo_report' format='pdf' at top. Reports page renders Brand Returns and Report Usage cards. Audit Logs page shows Download PDF + Download Excel buttons and Log Archives panel with 2026-Q1 + 2026-Q2 rows (archived, per-quarter Excel/PDF/Purge). Partners page shows Districts filter row + tag filters. Vendors page shows Sort dropdown (currently 'Sort: Name' — location option exists inside select; backend location_asc verified via pytest).
